description: This file defines data models and related structures for managing chat sessions and models within the OpenClawChat UI module. It includes definitions for chat model choices, session defaults, session entries, and a response structure for listing sessions.

methods.name: selectionID
methods.description: Constructs a provider-qualified model reference used for picker identity and selection tags.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Returns a display label based on the selection ID.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes instances of the respective structs with provided parameters.
